dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is working at the Transport Bureau really that stable?

dialogues.speaker: Znamensky
dialogues.text: It's less about stability, and more that... I don't really have a choice...

dialogues.speaker: Znamensky
dialogues.text: Back when I was young, I worked at the Snezhnograd Central Station. I made a severe scheduling oversight that led to a terrible accident. They shipped me off to Morepesok right after.

dialogues.speaker: Znamensky
dialogues.text: Honestly, I fell into a pretty dark place for a while, but I've come to terms with it now. No matter where you land, you've got to take pride in your work and do a proper job.
